title: Withered Blue Petal

sources.title: Withered Blue Petal
markers: {{SmItemIcon|Withered Blue Petal}} is a [[Miscellaneous]] item found in the basement of the [[Arcane Tower]]. Its purpose is to hint at how to start the generator again. Otherwise it has no known uses.

summary: Puzzle clue identifying what the Arcane Tower generator needs.

fields.Clue: Withered petals near the generator point to a fresh Sussur Bloom. The fresh bloom activates the tower and disables some defences. The withered petal itself has no known activation or crafting use.
fields.Acquisition: Three on the floor by the basement generator.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
